frozen_in: config/agent_points.yaml freezes each version and hash before the shadow window is recorded (step 12)
packing: the typed state first, then the retrieved chunks in rank order
each chunk fenced between UNTRUSTED START and UNTRUSTED END with its chunk id, document, version and the time it became known
a line inside a chunk that imitates a fence is defused, so no chunk closes its own fence
a chunk that would pass the budget is left out whole and counted, never cut
tokens estimated as four bytes of UTF-8 each, since every provider counts its own way
proven: every prompt file loads with its version hash and schema
a changed prompt file has a new hash
the typed state comes first and the evidence is fenced in rank order
a chunk cannot close its own fence or pass the budget
the estimate is four bytes a token
an answer that fails its schema twice is never taken
sentence: Each prompt is a versioned file whose hash every call records; every answer is validated against its Pydantic schema, retried once when it fails, and never taken when it fails twice.
